_comment: Lighting presets for pipeline/transformation/lighting_aug.py. Each value is a [min, max] range sampled per image (seeded). Casts are kept moderate on purpose: freshness is partly a colour cue, so a heavy warm cast could turn a label into a lie. low, warm and mixed are NOT in the default set (same families as the synthetic held-out copies); see lighting_aug.HELDOUT_FAMILY_PRESETS. Tune here, not in code.
